ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 macro-ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels visible across the surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity contiguous blobs occupy the lateral-distal quadrants of both lobes. A low-intensity central isthmus extends from the peduncle, bifurcating into thick bands along the trailing edges. Secondary low-intensity mottling is clustered in the medial-lower region of the left high-intensity zone.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 74 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/8th of the vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (~12-15 peaks per lobe); notably higher amplitude jaggedness is observed at the terminal distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed curve with a defined concavity originating at the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep toward the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of 5-7 circular high-intensity pixel points (probable barnacle colonization) located on the distal-most margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 4 distinct, near-parallel vertical low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) situated within the mid-field of the left high-intensity region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged erosion of the trailing edge topography; visible vertical linear tracks on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique low-intensity pigment 'peninsula' protruding into the high-intensity field at the upper-medial section of the left lobe.
